mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hong Kong notary public certification followed by a single Hague Apostille certificate issued by the Hong Kong High Court Authentication Registry; consular legalization is not used and must not be chained.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Hong Kong investor holding company board of directors
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Resolution executed under Hong Kong law, notarized by a Hong Kong notary public, then apostilled by the Hong Kong High Court Authentication Registry; for a director resident in a non-Hague state, notarization in that state plus consular legalization by the Chinese Embassy or Consulate would be the exclusive parallel path.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association (or Memorandum and Articles) of the Hong Kong investor holding company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Hong Kong investor holding company certified by the Hong Kong Companies Registry
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Certified true copy notarized by a Hong Kong notary public and apostilled by the Hong Kong High Court Authentication Registry under the Hague Convention; no consular legalization step may be added.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter issued by the Hong Kong investor's principal bank
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Bank-authorized signature and chop confirmed by a Hong Kong notary public, then apostilled by the Hong Kong High Court Authentication Registry; if the issuing bank is in a non-Hague state, the parallel method is notarization, competent authority authentication, and consular legalization at the PRC diplomatic post.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Protocol must screen all shareholders, directors, legal representatives, and beneficial owners at or above 25 percent against the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN and non-SDN sanctions lists, the EU consolidated financial sanctions list, and the domestic Chinese sanctioned-entity lists administered by the Ministry of Public Security and the Ministry of Commerce. PEPs are identified using a risk-based but mandatory data field covering domestic and foreign prominent public functions, immediate family members, and known close associates, with enhanced due diligence, source-of-wealth and source-of-funds verification, senior-management approval, and ongoing transaction monitoring for 12 months after relationship establishment. Negative news and adverse registry hits must be documented in a structured EDD file.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) Enterprise Name Autonomous Declaration System (China National Enterprise Name Declaration Portal)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The WFOE Chinese name must be composed of Chinese characters and must follow the statutory four-tier structure: administrative division plus trade name (字号) plus industry or operation characteristics plus organizational form, i.e., Limited Liability Company. The trade name must contain at least two Chinese characters, may be the transliteration of the foreign investor's name, and must not contain letters, numerals, or symbols except as specifically permitted by SAMR practice. An English name may be used as a parallel business name only after the Chinese name is registered and only in accordance with local SAMR rules. Pinyin or romanization is not a statutory substitute for the Chinese-character name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: An expiring name reservation should be renewed only by filing a fresh application through the SAMR autonomous declaration portal before the original 30-day window lapses, because automatic extension is not nationally standardized. If the portal rejects a proposed name, the applicant should first amend the four-tier components and resubmit. If the rejection is based on a substantive conflict or prohibited token, the applicant must file a written administrative reconsideration application with the superior administrative organ or the same SAMR registration authority, as applicable, within 60 days of the rejection notice, attaching the rejection receipt, proposed name, trademark or priority evidence, and explanatory memorandum. The applicant must demand a written ruling within the statutory period and may thereafter bring an administrative lawsuit in the competent people's court within six months. Any appeal deadline must be tracked in the formation calendar.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office or commercial-mailbox registered address is rejected for a mainland China WFOE engaged in ISIC 3240 wooden puzzle laser cutting and assembly. SAMR requires a real, lease-based address corresponding to a business premises. The municipal tax bureau for VAT invoice controls and commercial banks for basic deposit account opening independently require on-site inspection and visible business operations. A laser assembly facility needs physical plant, electricity capacity, laser safety controls, raw-material storage, packaging line, and employee presence; a virtual office cannot satisfy Chinese commercial substance tests and will trigger adverse tax risk rating.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Checklist for unannounced physical inspection: original lease contract and landlord real-estate title certificate; on-site production floor with CO2 laser cutting machines and ventilation and fire-safety equipment; raw wood inventory and finished wooden puzzle goods; employment contracts and social insurance records; VAT invoice system, receipt scanner, and accounting records; water, electricity, and internet bills matching the registered address; company statutory chop and legal representative identification; safety and environmental occupational health certificates where applicable. Quantified risk: high risk, 70-85 percent likelihood of an unannounced inspection by the municipal tax authority, SAMR, or jointly by relevant authorities within the first 12 months of registration, especially after first VAT issuance, export customs filing, or cross-border e-commerce platform listing; probability drops to approximately 20-30 percent in later years if the taxpayer has a clean compliance record and stable physical operations.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Revision), Articles 4, 23, 24, 32, 37, 47, 59, 98 and 100; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (2019), Articles 4 and 31; Regulations on the Registration of Companies of the People's Republic of China
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and the local Municipal Market Supervision Administration with territorial jurisdiction over the registered office of the Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Registration of Establishment of a Foreign-Invested Company together with the Approved Articles of Association and the Name Reservation Notice
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: There is no statutory minimum registered capital for a general manufacturing WFOE under the PRC Company Law, and no blocked escrow account rule applies to ordinary wooden toy manufacturing. The shareholders must set a reasonable subscribed capital in the Articles of Association and contribute it in full within five years from the date of establishment unless a shorter schedule is adopted in the Articles or required by a specific industrial regulator. The registered capital may be paid in cash or in appraised non-cash assets, and a bank capital contribution account should be opened to route investment remittances from Hong Kong. No mandatory capital verification report is required for SAMR registration in a non-restricted manufacturing sector, although the bank may request source-of-funds evidence and the local foreign exchange regulator may require a capital account filing upon inward remittance.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION OF THE FIRST BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF CN WFOE LIMITED. Adopted by unanimous written consent in lieu of a meeting on [date], subject to the effectiveness of the Company's establishment registration. WHEREAS, the Company is a Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise formed under the laws of the People's Republic of China with limited liability; WHEREAS, the Articles of Association and applicable law require that the initial board set the capital, banking, office and officer structure. NOW, THEREFORE, IT IS HEREBY RESOLVED AS FOLLOWS. 1. Share Capital and Subscription. The registered capital of the Company is fixed at RMB [amount], divided into [number] ordinary shares with a par value of RMB [amount] each. The sole shareholder is hereby authorized and directed to subscribe in full to the entire registered capital and to contribute the subscribed amount in cash or in kind in accordance with the capital contribution schedule contained in the Articles of Association, provided that all contributions shall be completed within five years from the date of incorporation. The Directors are authorized to issue capital contribution certificates and to record all contributions in the statutory register. 2. Banking Authorization. The Company shall open a basic deposit account, a capital contribution account and such ancillary foreign currency accounts as may be required with [Bank]. [Name], Legal Representative, and [Name], Chief Financial Officer, are hereby appointed as the authorized signatories with the signing powers and transaction limits set out in the written banking mandate. The bank mandate is ratified and the Officers are directed to execute all account opening agreements and indemnities. 3. Registered Office. The registered office and statutory mailing address of the Company is fixed at [address]. The Legal Representative is authorized to sign the lease, obtain landlord consent, accept service of process, and complete all address filings with the State Administration for Market Regulation. 4. Statutory Officer Appointments. [Name] is appointed as Legal Representative and Executive Director; [Name] is appointed as Supervisor; [Name] is appointed as General Manager; and [Name] is appointed as Company Secretary and Compliance Manager. The Legal Representative shall represent the Company in all legal and business matters, the General Manager shall conduct ordinary operations, the Supervisor shall exercise supervisory powers, and the Company Secretary shall maintain minutes, registers and governmental filings. 5. General Authority. All Directors and Officers are authorized, jointly and severally, to execute and deliver any incorporation, banking, environmental, fire safety, occupational health, tax, customs and industrial licensing documents, and to procure all certificates and permits necessary for the commencement of the Company's ISIC 3240 wooden puzzle laser assembly operations. This resolution is effective upon issuance of the Company's business license and remains in force until revoked by a subsequent board resolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-Registration Name Reservation and Foreign Investment Negative List Screening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SAMR National Enterprise Registration online portal and the local Municipal Market Supervision Administration
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the SAMR National Enterprise Registration online portal or the local Government Integrated Services Platform. Conduct a foreign investment screening to confirm that the proposed ISIC 3240 wooden puzzle laser assembly business is outside the Foreign Investment Negative List and does not fall within a restricted or prohibited industry. Submit the enterprise name reservation application with the proposed English and Chinese name, the primary business scope clause aligned to toy and game manufacturing, and the proposed registered address. Attach the preliminary Articles of Association and the proposed capital contribution timetable. Verify that the proposed Legal Representative is a natural person with full civil capacity and no statutory disqualification. After the name reservation is granted, download the Name Reservation Notice and proceed to prepare the final formation instruments.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application
Proposed Articles of Association
Passport or identity certificate of the proposed Legal Representative
Business scope and industry code justification
Preliminary registered address particulars and landlord consent
Certificate of Incorporation of the Hong Kong shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected, promptly submit a fresh name reservation application with three alternative names and a revised explanatory note. If the negative-list screening flags the proposed scope, file a written clarification with the local commerce department; if the activity remains prohibited, restructure the scope or abandon the specific reserved name and re-file.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation, Notarization and Transmission of Hong Kong Investor Corporate Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: China-appointed Notary Public in Hong Kong SAR and China Legal Service (Hong Kong) transmission office; subsequently the receiving Municipal Market Supervision Administration
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a China-appointed notary public in Hong Kong to produce certified true copies of the Hong Kong shareholder's Certificate of Incorporation, Business Registration Certificate, directors and shareholder registers, Certificate of Incumbency, a resolution approving the formation of the mainland WFOE, and specimen signatures of the authorised signatory. The notary must attest the duplicate documents and transmit them to the China Legal Service (Hong Kong) office for the statutory add-on transmission to the mainland. Prepare the final PRC-law Articles of Association, the sole shareholder resolution on capital subscription and contribution schedule, the appointment instruments for the Legal Representative and Supervisor, and the registered office lease certificate. Ensure all documents carry the notary number and transmission stamp before submission.
required_dossiers: Notarized Certificate of Incorporation of Hong Kong shareholder
Notarized Business Registration Certificate of Hong Kong shareholder
Notarized Certificate of Incumbency and director register
Board resolution of Hong Kong shareholder approving WFOE formation
Specimen signatures of authorized representatives
Certified English-Chinese translations of all notarized instruments
Draft Articles of Association and capital contribution schedule
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or transmission office rejects any document because of irregular execution, cure by re-executing the underlying Hong Kong shareholder resolution and re-attesting the fresh duplicates. If the SAMR or transmission agency identifies a translation or legalization gap, submit certified supplementary translations and the original notarized file within the rectification deadline.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Establishment Registration and Issuance of WFOE Business License
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Municipal Market Supervision Administration with jurisdiction over the registered office, acting under SAMR
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the complete formation dossier to the local Municipal Market Supervision Administration through its integrated enterprise registration platform or physical service window. The authorized filer shall upload the Name Reservation Notice, the establishment registration application, the final Articles of Association, the notarized Hong Kong investor documents, the registered address certificate, the appointment instruments for the Legal Representative, General Manager and Supervisor, and the capital contribution schedule. Pay or evidence exemption from the zero official registration fee. The authority will verify the name, business scope, governance structure, capital schedule and address. If all conditions are satisfied, it will issue the unified social credit code and the WFOE Business License. The company thereafter completes tax, statistics, customs, social insurance and housing fund notifications integrated into the multi-license system.
required_dossiers: Establishment registration application form
Name Reservation Notice
Final Articles of Association executed by all shareholders
Notarized Hong Kong shareholder corporate documents and transmission certificate
Registered office lease and landlord ownership certificate
Appointment letters for Legal Representative, General Manager and Supervisor
Capital contribution schedule
Identity certificates of all proposed officers and directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If SAMR issues a rectification notice, cure the cited defects and resubmit within the statutory period. If registration is suspended because of an unclear business scope, provide the ISIC/NAICS justification and a revised scope clause. In the event of final rejection, file an administrative reconsideration within 60 days or prepare a corrected formation dossier and re-apply.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Seals, Banking, Foreign Exchange, Taxation and Employment Formalities
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Public Security Bureau-authorized seal engraving enterprises, commercial bank, State Administration of Foreign Exchange local branch, State Taxation Administration local bureau, social insurance and housing fund authorities
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After receiving the Business License, the Legal Representative shall engage a licensed seal engraving house authorized by the public security bureau to cut the company seal, finance seal, contract seal, invoice seal and legal representative seal, and to file the seal impressions. The Company shall then open a basic RMB deposit account and a foreign exchange capital account at a bank licensed for foreign currency business. Present the Business License, unified social credit code certificate, seal registration certificate, Legal Representative identity document and the registered office lease. Complete the foreign exchange registration through the bank for future capital remittances from Hong Kong. Register with the local tax authority for VAT, corporate income tax, withholding tax, invoice quota and stamp duty status. Complete payroll, social insurance and housing fund registration for all initial employees.
required_dossiers: Business License and unified social credit code certificate
Seal registration certificate issued by public security bureau
Legal Representative and officer identity certificates
Lease contract and landlord title evidence
Bank account opening application and AML/KYC forms
Source of funds and beneficial ownership declaration
Tax registration supplementary form
Social insurance and housing fund registration forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests enhanced due diligence for the Hong Kong shareholder, supply the corporate group chart, ultimate beneficial owner declarations, source of funds and bank statements. If foreign exchange registration is delayed, submit the revised capital contribution schedule and bank refusal letter to the local SAFE office. For tax registration delays, file a late registration explanation and pay any nominal late fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Industrial, Environmental, Fire Safety and Occupational Licensing Completion
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Municipal Ecological Environment Bureau; local Fire and Rescue Department; local Market Supervision Administration; local Emergency Management or Work Safety authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a site-specific environmental classification under the MEE Construction Project Environmental Impact Assessment Classification List. For low-volume dry wooden puzzle laser assembly, file an Environmental Impact Registration. If laser cutting capacity, wood finishing, painting or hazardous waste generation exceeds thresholds, commission a certified EIA consultant to prepare and submit an Environmental Impact Report Form. Submit floor plans and fire protection drawings to the local Fire and Rescue Department for fire design filing; after equipment installation, apply for fire acceptance filing or inspection. Engage a qualified testing body to verify product compliance with GB 6675 toy safety standards and, if the product falls within the Compulsory Certification catalogue, obtain China Compulsory Certification before placing toys on the market. Sign hazardous waste disposal contracts, implement dust and fume extraction, and file the Emergency Response Plan for Production Safety Accidents.
required_dossiers: Business License
Registered office lease and layout drawings
Process description and materials safety data sheets
Laser cutting equipment specifications and laser safety certificates
Environmental Impact Registration or EIA Report documentation
Fire protection design drawings and acceptance application
Hazardous waste disposal contract and manifest records
Toy product quality inspection reports
CCC application dossier if triggered
Work safety emergency response plan and occupational hazard assessment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the environmental authority upgrades the filing to an EIA Report Form, engage a certified environmental engineering institute, conduct public participation where applicable, and submit the additional studies. If the Fire and Rescue Department requires rectification, implement the prescribed fire separation, suppression and evacuation measures and request reinspection. If a toy product fails CCC or toy safety testing, re-engineer the product, submit a new sample for testing, and suspend sales until certification is obtained.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and the local Municipal Administration for Market Regulation, together with the local Municipal Ecological Environment Bureau, Fire and Rescue Department, and Emergency Management Bureau
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business License with Manufacturing Business Scope for ISIC 3240 Toy Manufacturing, supplemented by the China Compulsory Certification (CCC) for toy products if triggered and the Fire Safety Acceptance Certificate

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Ecology and Environment (MEE) and the local Municipal Ecological Environment Bureau
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Environmental Impact Registration for small-scale dry laser cutting and assembly of wooden puzzles; upgrade to Environmental Impact Report Form if laser cutting volume, surface treatment, painting, lamination or hazardous waste generation crosses the thresholds in the MEE Classification List, and to a full Environmental Impact Report if significant air, water or hazardous waste impacts are identified.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater from domestic sources discharged to municipal sewers must meet GB/T 31962-2015 or the applicable local sewer standard, with typical limits of COD not exceeding 500 mg/L, BOD not exceeding 300 mg/L, SS not exceeding 400 mg/L and ammonia nitrogen not exceeding 45 mg/L. Laser cutting exhaust must be captured and treated through bag filtration and activated carbon adsorption; particulate matter must comply with GB 16297-1996 or stricter local limits, and non-methane total hydrocarbons must be kept within the applicable VOC emission standards such as GB 37822-2019. Hazardous wastes including waste activated carbon, laser ash, resins and waste oils must be stored in accordance with GB 18597-2023 and transferred only to licensed hazardous waste treatment operators. Boundary noise must meet GB 12348-2008, with maximum permissible levels of 65 dB(A) by day and 55 dB(A) by night for industrial premises.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: The leased workshop must undergo fire protection design filing and fire acceptance filing or inspection before production begins. The local Fire and Rescue Department will verify emergency egress, fire extinguishers, fire separation, emergency lighting, smoke control and the storage of flammable materials used with laser equipment. A civil defense and structural load inspection by a licensed design institute is required for laser cutting gantries, heavy work tables, compressed air systems and dust collectors. Occupational safety clearance requires laser-safe eyewear, local exhaust ventilation, a production safety emergency response plan filing, regular occupational hazard monitoring, and work safety standardization if mandated by the local Emergency Management Bureau. No separate civil defense shelter obligation applies unless design flood or underground construction requirements are triggered by the lease premises.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) of the People's Republic of China, accessed through the China Taxpayer Service Portal (etax.chinatax.gov.cn) and the China Customs Single Window for trade-related data; for the Hong Kong SAR parent, the relevant authority is the Inland Revenue Department of Hong Kong but it is not the operative tax registration authority for the mainland WFOE.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a Hong Kong-invested Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise (WFOE), separate tax registration is not a stand-alone application. The WFOE is first incorporated with the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and obtains a Unified Social Credit Code (USCC), which serves as the statutory taxpayer identification number (TIN) and VAT taxpayer identification number for all tax purposes. The SAMR establishment record is electronically synchronized to the State Taxation Administration, thereby completing the WFOE's basic tax registration under the multi-department integrated registration system. The WFOE must then log into the China Taxpayer Service Portal to complete supplementary registration details, including legal representative identity, registered and business addresses, bank account records, accounting and bookkeeping arrangements, and authorized tax agents or financial officers. If the WFOE seeks general VAT taxpayer status, it must file the corresponding status election through the portal. For a foreign non-resident enterprise without an establishment in mainland China but deriving China-source income, the foreign entity is separately registered as a non-resident taxpayer with the competent STA branch, or the Chinese withholding agent performs tax registration and withholding obligations on its behalf. All filings, assessments, invoices, and tax refunds are referenced to the USCC/TIN.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation (the Chinese WFOE is a Chinese resident enterprise under the Enterprise Income Tax Law, taxed at entity level on worldwide income; it is not a pass-through vehicle and does not qualify for Hong Kong territorial taxation in mainland China).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: China does not have a US-style check-the-box election or hybrid mismatch election regime. The available statutory elections are limited to VAT status and method elections: (1) election to be registered as a general VAT taxpayer on a voluntary basis where annual taxable sales are at or below CNY 5,000,000; (2) mandatory registration as a general VAT taxpayer once annual taxable sales exceed CNY 5,000,000; (3) election by qualifying small-scale VAT taxpayers to use the simplified VAT calculation method; and (4) election by general VAT taxpayers in certain statutory sectors to use the simplified method where expressly permitted. No transparent entity or pass-through election is available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value-Added Tax (VAT) supplemented by an export VAT zero-rating and input VAT credit/refund mechanism for exported goods.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: There is no mandatory minimum turnover threshold for basic VAT/tax registration; any business engaged in taxable activities in mainland China must register for VAT. However, mandatory registration as a general VAT taxpayer is triggered when annual taxable sales exceed CNY 5,000,000. Businesses with annual taxable sales at or below CNY 5,000,000 are automatically treated as small-scale VAT taxpayers unless they voluntarily elect general VAT taxpayer status.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: The State Taxation Administration requires the use of the nationwide fully digitalized electronic VAT invoice system. Qualified taxpayers issue VAT invoices directly through the China Taxpayer Service Portal or through STA-approved third-party electronic invoicing platforms connected to the Unified Electronic Invoice Service Platform. Invoice data is transmitted to the STA in real time at the time of issuance. Each fully digitalized e-invoice carries a unique global invoice identifier, a dynamic anti-fraud QR code, an encrypted ciphertext/electronically controlled tax stamp, and is validated by the STA's fiscal clearance system. Physical paper stamping and tax-control discs are no longer required for fully digitalized e-invoices. Taxpayers with high-volumne systems may obtain STA-approved application programming interface (API) integration for system-to-system invoice issuance and real-time clearance.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exported goods are eligible for the export VAT zero-rating (0% VAT) rather than an exemption, meaning the exporter may credit and refund input VAT attributable to the exported wooden puzzle production and laser assembly process. The statutory eligibility criteria are: (1) the goods are sold to a customer outside mainland China and physically leave China customs territory; (2) the exporter is a registered general VAT taxpayer; (3) the export transaction is properly declared to and released by the General Administration of Customs of the People's Republic of China (GACC); (4) export proceeds are received in foreign currency and repatriated through a designated foreign exchange bank in accordance with State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) rules; (5) the VAT invoice, commercial invoice, contract, packing list, and customs declaration data are consistent; and (6) input VAT on domestic purchases of raw materials, components, CO2 laser processing services, and related overheads is supported by valid fully digitalized e-invoices. Goods sold domestically within mainland China remain subject to standard VAT at 13% and cannot be zero-rated.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Export Goods Declaration Form with GACC release status and customs supervisory records)
Bill of Lading (or air waybill or multimodal transport document) evidencing physical departure from China customs territory
Commercial invoice and export sales contract
Packing list for the exported wooden puzzle consignment
Export VAT invoice issued through the STA fully digitalized e-invoice system
Foreign exchange repatriation proof: Export Proceeds Receipt, Inward Remittance Certificate (FIRC), or designated bank statement confirming receipt of export proceeds in foreign currency
Electronic matching data from the China Customs Single Window used by STA and SAFE for export verification
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export VAT zero-rating and refund claims are subject to post-export audit by the State Taxation Administration, which cross-verifies GACC customs release records, SAFE foreign exchange receipt data, and fully digitalized e-invoice issuance data. If a zero-rating claim is not substantiated, the STA will disallow and retrospectively claw back the refunded VAT and related input VAT credits, impose a late surcharge of 0.05% per day on the outstanding amount, and may impose an administrative tax penalty of between 50% and five times the refunded amount under the Law on the Administration of Tax Collection. Where fraudulent export declarations, false invoicing, or deliberate export tax refund fraud are established, the case may be referred for criminal prosecution under the Criminal Law, which can result in imprisonment, confiscation of property, and additional fines.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: People's Bank of China (PBOC) and its State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: China operates a managed floating RMB regime with dual-tier convertibility. Current account items (trade, service payments, wages, dividends) are effectively convertible under a genuine trade-based verification system: banks must examine supporting documents but no SAFE quota approval is required. Capital account items remain regulated. Inbound FDI equity into a Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise is permissible after SAFE's Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) registration; the registered capital must be received onshore into a designated FDI foreign currency capital account and may be settled into RMB only after verification of the actual purpose and use is within the permitted business scope and not on the negative list. Profit remittance operates through the current account: the WFOE must provide audited financial statements, tax filings, payment vouchers, and board resolutions to evidence distributable profits, after which the bank remits via wire with a foreign exchange declaration. There is no free parity liquidity for converted RMB to be used for offshore investment or unapproved shareholder loans. Export proceeds are no longer subject to mandatory surrender into RMB, but must be repatriated and reported through the goods-trade monitoring system. This framework requires the WFOE to maintain bank-level compliance procedures, including real-time documentation of trade settlement and a full audit trail for every cross-border receipt and payment.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no statutory surrender percentage and no mandatory conversion ratio for export proceeds in China. Export receipts may be held in a foreign currency goods-trade settlement account or converted into RMB at a licensed bank at the prevailing interbank rate. Proceeds must generally be repatriated onshore within the contractual trade term and should be received no later than 90 days after the customs export declaration unless a delayed collection reason is pre-reported to SAFE through the goods-trade monitoring system. The exporter must support each receipt with the sales contract, customs declaration, logistics documents, and invoicing records. Overdue or unmatched export receipts may be flagged as foreign exchange trading anomalies, leading to settlement account restrictions and downgrading of the enterprise classification under SAFE.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low (1/10) as a primary settlement bank. Offshore digital EMI platforms are not licensed deposit-taking banks in mainland China and cannot independently clear through CIPS, perform SAFE balance-of-payments declarations, open a PRC corporate current account, or provide SAFE-compliant capital account settlement. They may act only as supplementary collection gateways through a Chinese partner bank. For the WFOE treasury, all core cross-border banking, FX conversion, and regulatory reporting must be executed through a licensed domestic Tier-1 commercial bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is the statutory default. PRC corporate account-opening rules and anti-money laundering controls require the legal representative and, where applicable, senior controlling officers to attend the bank branch in person for a face-to-face KYC interview and signature verification. Remote consular proxy opening is not accepted for the first account opening. The bank will verify the original business license, company chops, shareholder resolutions, lease agreements, and factory premises; a site inspection is routine for a manufacturing WFOE.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opacity in the Hong Kong parent ownership chain and difficulty identifying the ultimate beneficial owner of the WFOE.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified Hong Kong Certificate of Incumbent, Registered Office address, annual return, register of members, UBO declaration for all natural persons above 10% ownership, source of wealth documentation including bank statements and tax records for the past 12 months, notarized corporate structure tree, and valid passports of all beneficial owners.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Insufficient physical substance for a laser cutting and wooden puzzle assembly operation, which may indicate a shell or conduit company.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Lease agreement covering the manufacturing facility, industrial electricity and utility invoices, CO2 laser machine purchase invoices and maintenance logs, payroll and social insurance contribution records for production staff, raw wood material purchase receipts, packaging supplier contracts, and site photographs.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume low-value e-commerce receipts from Amazon Pay and Stripe that do not match conventional export invoices, creating a false trade red flag.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Amazon Pay and Stripe payout statements showing settlement cycles and fee deductions, e-commerce order reconciliation files, underlying sales contracts with the HK or overseas seller entity, export customs declarations, logistics waybills, proof of goods delivery, and a clear business license covering toy manufacturing and online trading.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound equity injection from the Hong Kong shareholder is inconsistent with the SAFE FDI registration or uses an incorrect foreign exchange purpose code.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: SAFE FDI Foreign Exchange Registration Form, HK shareholder board resolution approving capital subscription, written share subscription commitment, source of funds statements from the HK shareholder's bank, remittance instruction citing the FDI direct investment capital contribution purpose code, and, where necessary, a PRC CPA capital verification report.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The Hong Kong parent must wire equity capital through a licensed bank via SWIFT MT103 for USD/HKD or via the Cross-Border Interbank Payment System (CIPS) if payment is made in RMB, into the WFOE's SAFE-registered FDI Foreign Exchange Capital Account. The remittance instruction must cite the SAFE FDI registration number and the inbound direct investment capital contribution purpose code from the balance-of-payments code list. Upon receipt, the bank credits the capital account, the WFOE issues the corresponding share register update, and a PRC certified accountant may be engaged to produce a capital verification report for the shareholders and bank. RMB settlement is executed by the receiving bank from the foreign currency capital account into a dedicated RMB Capital Settlement Account. The WFOE must preserve invoices and contracts supporting subsequent disbursements because converted capital cannot be used for prohibited investments, onshore equity speculation, or unapproved shareholder loans.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Domestic purchases of wood panels, laser optics, packaging, and freight services are settled through the RMB basic account via CNAPS high-value transfers or online bank bulk payment rails. Cross-border supplier payments are made through SWIFT MT103 wire transfers after bank validation of the trade contract and trade purpose code. Import-heavy purchases from HK or Asia can use a bank-issued Commercial Letter of Credit and Documentary Collections routed through the bank's trade services centre. For export receipts arising from Amazon Pay and Stripe, the payment service provider or its payout bank aggregates customer settlements and sends net proceeds by SWIFT MT103 to the WFOE's Goods Trade Export Settlement Account; the bank reconciles the receipt against customs declarations and e-commerce order records before allowing onward use.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Full-deliverable CNY/USD FX forwards entered into with a licensed PRC bank to hedge genuine current-account trade receipts and payments, subject to SAFE real underlying transaction documentation and a bank-approved exposure limit.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are not permissible onshore for a mainland WFOE; only the offshore Hong Kong parent may enter NDFs outside the PRC and never with onshore RMB settlement or linked to the WFOE's capital account funds.

FX swaps and cross-currency swaps are permissible only for maturity-matching liquidity needs of trade settlement and are forbidden if used for speculation, arbitrage, or circumvention of China's capital account controls under SAFE regulations.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: PRC WFOE Annual Business Information Report (Annual Report) under the PRC Foreign Investment Law and Interim Regulations on Enterprise Information Disclosure
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) via the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System and the local SAMR branch where the WFOE is registered
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually between 1 January and 30 June of the year following the reporting calendar year (the FY2024 report is due by 30 June 2025)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file within the window triggers inclusion on the Operating Abnormal List; continuing failure for three consecutive years allows SAMR to revoke the business licence; a fine of RMB 10,000 (approx. USD 1,400) may also be imposed, and the entity's public credit record will be adversely marked.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: PRC Corporate Income Tax Annual Final Settlement Return and final settlement tax payment, accompanied by audited financial statements and tax reconciliation (企业所得税年度汇算清缴)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) through the competent PRC tax authority and the official electronic tax filing platform
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 May of the year following the fiscal year end, being a five-month statutory filing window from 31 December year end; extension rules apply only where lawfully permitted
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalties are generally RMB 2,000 (approx. USD 280) for ordinary cases and RMB 2,000-RMB 10,000 (approx. USD 280-USD 1,400) for aggravated non-compliance; late payment interest accrues at 0.05% per day on the outstanding tax; compulsory collection measures, bank account freezes, and seizure of assets may follow.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Hong Kong Annual Return (NAR1) for the Hong Kong connected structuring private limited entity
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 42 days after the anniversary of the company's incorporation, annually for a private company limited by shares
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late registration fees escalate according to the delay: HKD 870 (approx. USD 112) for more than 42 days but not more than 3 months; HKD 1,740 (approx. USD 223) for more than 3 months but not more than 6 months; HKD 2,610 (approx. USD 335) for more than 6 months but not more than 9 months; HKD 3,480 (approx. USD 447) for more than 9 months but not more than 12 months; further default may lead to prosecution and administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Hong Kong Business Registration Certificate Renewal for the Hong Kong connected entity or branch
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Inland Revenue Department (IRD), Business Registration Office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within one month before the expiry of the current Business Registration Certificate; the certificate has a one-year validity period and must be renewed each year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unpaid business registration fees and levies attract a late penalty of HKD 5,000 (approx. USD 641), plus recovery of three times the unpaid annual fee and levy; carrying on business without a valid certificate is an offence and IRD may commence debt recovery and prosecution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Hong Kong Profits Tax Return (BIR51), together with audited financial statements and tax computation for the Hong Kong connected entity
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Generally within one month from the date the Profits Tax Return is issued; where a recognised tax representative is engaged, the deadline for an accounting period ending 31 December is normally extended to 15 August for e-filing and 15 November for paper filing, subject to IRD practice notes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: IRD may issue an estimated assessment on a failure to file; civil penalties include HKD 10,000 (approx. USD 1,282) per offence plus an additional surcharge of up to 100% of the understated tax; sustained default may lead to prosecution and recovery proceedings.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: PRC Company Law (2018, as amended) Article 164 requires every company, including a wholly foreign-owned enterprise, to close its books at the end of each fiscal year and to have its annual financial statements independently audited by an accounting firm; there is no quantitative balance-sheet, turnover, or headcount exemption for the WFOE audit mandate. The PRC Foreign Investment Law and the Interim Regulations on Enterprise Information Disclosure likewise require the WFOE's audited annual financial information to be reported through the SAMR Annual Report mechanism. For the Hong Kong connected entity, the Hong Kong Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622) requires every incorporated company to prepare annual financial statements and have them audited by a certified public accountant; the only statutory audit exemption is the dormant-company regime, which requires a special resolution and no significant accounting transactions. No turnover, asset, or employee thresholds exempt an active private company in Hong Kong from the statutory audit obligation. The applicable standards are China Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (CASBE) for the PRC WFOE and Hong Kong Financial Reporting Standards (HKFRS), HKFRS for Private Entities, or the HK SME Financial Reporting Framework for the Hong Kong connected entity.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: PRC WFOE: China Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (CASBE), substantially converged with IFRS as issued by the IASB; eligible small-scale enterprises may apply the PRC Small Business Accounting Standards. Hong Kong connected entity: HKFRS, HKFRS for Private Entities, or the HK SME Financial Reporting Framework as selected and consistently applied under the Hong Kong Companies Ordinance.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: For the PRC WFOE, there is no standalone annual beneficial-owner confirmation filing; ownership and ultimate controlling party information must be disclosed through the SAMR Annual Report, and any change in shareholders, registered capital, or ultimate beneficial ownership must be registered with SAMR within 30 days of the change, alongside applicable tax and foreign-exchange reporting obligations. For the Hong Kong connected entity, a Significant Controllers Register must be maintained at the registered office in accordance with the Companies Ordinance; all registrable persons (shareholders with 25% or more beneficial interest or control) must be recorded, and any change to that register must be completed within 7 days of the company becoming aware of it. There is no autonomous annual filing of the Hong Kong Significant Controllers Register to the Companies Registry, but the NAR1 Annual Return annually confirms member and corporate information.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,500 - USD 9,000 per annum for combined statutory audits of the PRC WFOE and the related Hong Kong connected entity, depending on transaction volume, complexity, and service-provider scale
